highlights.note_en: Look for numbers that cancel each other out.

highlights.phrase_en: Compute:

trap.why_en: Adding all numbers without cancelling gives 6000, but –975 and –1025 reduce it.

questions.body_en: The word CHAMPION is written repeatedly to form a long sequence (CHAMPIONCHAMPION…….). What is the letter at the 980th position in this sequence?

highlights.phrase_en: CHAMPION

highlights.note_id: CHAMPION memiliki 8 huruf: C(1) H(2) A(3) M(4) P(5) I(6) O(7) N(8).

highlights.phrase_en: 980th position
highlights.note_en: Find which letter of CHAMPION falls at position 980.
highlights.note_id: Cari huruf CHAMPION mana yang jatuh di posisi 980.

highlights.phrase_en: written repeatedly
highlights.note_en: The pattern repeats every 8 letters.
highlights.note_id: Polanya berulang setiap 8 huruf.

strategy.name_en: Find remainder after dividing by cycle length
strategy.name_id: Cari sisa bagi panjang siklus

hint_steps_en: CHAMPION has 8 letters. The pattern repeats every 8.
Remainder 4 means the 4th letter: C-H-A-M → M.
hint_steps_id: CHAMPION memiliki 8 huruf. Pola berulang setiap 8.
Sisa 4 berarti huruf ke-4: C-H-A-M → M.

questions.body_en: Uncle has 245 goats. He wants to divide the goats equally into 22 pens, with each pen holding 12 goats. How many more goats does Uncle need to fill all the pens completely?
questions.body_id: Paman memiliki 245 ekor kambing. Ia ingin membagi kambing tersebut sama rata ke 22 kandang di mana setiap kandang berisi 12 ekor kambing. Berapa ekor kambing lagikah yang dibutuhkan paman agar semua kandang terisi penuh?

highlights.phrase_en: 245 goats
highlights.note_en: This is how many goats Uncle has right now.
highlights.note_id: Ini jumlah kambing yang dimiliki Paman sekarang.

highlights.phrase_en: 22 pens, with each pen holding 12 goats
highlights.phrase_id: 22 kandang di mana setiap kandang berisi 12 ekor kambing
highlights.note_en: Total needed = 22 × 12 = 264 goats.
highlights.note_id: Total yang dibutuhkan = 22 × 12 = 264 kambing.

highlights.phrase_en: How many more goats does Uncle need
highlights.phrase_id: Berapa ekor kambing lagikah yang dibutuhkan paman
highlights.note_en: Subtract what he has from what he needs.
highlights.note_id: Kurangi yang dimiliki dari yang dibutuhkan.

strategy.name_en: Find total needed, then subtract
strategy.name_id: Cari total yang dibutuhkan, lalu kurangi

trap.why_en: 245 ÷ 12 = 20 r5, so 5 left over — confusing remainder with the shortage.
trap.why_id: 245 ÷ 12 = 20 sisa 5, sehingga membingungkan sisa bagi dengan kekurangan.

hint_steps_en: Uncle has 245, so he needs 264 – 245 = 19 more.
hint_steps_id: Total kambing yang dibutuhkan: 22 kandang × 12 ekor = 264.
Paman punya 245, jadi ia butuh 264 – 245 = 19 lagi.

questions.body_en: Given: apple + 2 oranges = 16; orange + 2 pineapples = 22; pineapple – grapes = 6. If apple = 4, how much does pineapple + orange × grapes = ?
questions.body_id: Diketahui: apel + 2 jeruk = 16; jeruk + 2 nanas = 22; nanas – anggur = 6. Jika apel = 4, berapakah nilai nanas + jeruk × anggur = ?

highlights.phrase_en: apple = 4
highlights.note_en: Start here to find orange from the first equation.
highlights.note_id: Mulai dari sini untuk mencari jeruk dari persamaan pertama.

highlights.phrase_en: apple + 2 oranges = 16; orange + 2 pineapples = 22; pineapple – grapes = 6
highlights.phrase_id: apel + 2 jeruk = 16; jeruk + 2 nanas = 22; nanas – anggur = 6
highlights.note_en: Three equations to solve one by one.
highlights.note_id: Tiga persamaan yang diselesaikan satu per satu.

highlights.phrase_en: pineapple + orange × grapes
highlights.note_en: Multiply first (PEMDAS), then add.
highlights.note_id: Kalikan dulu (operasi hitung), lalu tambahkan.

strategy.name_en: Solve equations in chain, apply order of operations
strategy.name_id: Selesaikan persamaan berantai, terapkan urutan operasi

trap.why_en: Adding first before multiplying: (8+6)×2 = 28. Always multiply before adding.
trap.why_id: Menjumlahkan dulu sebelum mengalikan: (8+6)×2 = 28. Selalu kalikan sebelum menjumlahkan.

questions.body_en: The sum of three consecutive whole numbers (3 numbers next to one another) is 87. What is the product of the smallest and largest of these numbers?
questions.body_id: Jumlah dari tiga bilangan bulat berurutan (3 bilangan yang bersebelahan) adalah 87. Berapakah hasil kali dari bilangan terkecil dan terbesar dari bilangan-bilangan tersebut?

highlights.phrase_en: sum of three consecutive whole numbers (3 numbers next to one another) is 87
highlights.phrase_id: Jumlah dari tiga bilangan bulat berurutan (3 bilangan yang bersebelahan) adalah 87
highlights.note_en: The middle number = 87 ÷ 3 = 29.
highlights.note_id: Bilangan tengah = 87 ÷ 3 = 29.

highlights.phrase_en: product of the smallest and largest
highlights.phrase_id: hasil kali dari bilangan terkecil dan terbesar
highlights.note_en: Multiply the first and third numbers.
highlights.note_id: Kalikan bilangan pertama dan ketiga.

strategy.name_en: Middle of consecutive numbers = average
strategy.name_id: Bilangan tengah = rata-rata

hint_steps_en: For three consecutive numbers, the middle one equals the average: 87 ÷ 3 = 29.
hint_steps_id: Untuk tiga bilangan berurutan, bilangan tengah sama dengan rata-ratanya: 87 ÷ 3 = 29.

questions.body_en: Indy has 28 stickers fewer than Oby. Beny has twice as many stickers as Indy. Chad has 18 fewer stickers than Beny. Han has half as many stickers as Chad. If Oby has 90 stickers, how many stickers altogether?
questions.body_id: Indy memiliki 28 stiker lebih sedikit daripada Oby. Beny memiliki dua kali lipat jumlah stiker Indy. Chad memiliki 18 stiker lebih sedikit dari Beny. Han memiliki separuh dari jumlah stiker Chad. Jika Oby memiliki 90 stiker, berapa banyak seluruh stiker mereka?

highlights.phrase_en: Oby has 90 stickers
highlights.note_en: Start here and work down the chain.
highlights.note_id: Mulai dari sini dan ikuti rantainya.

highlights.phrase_en: Indy has 28 stickers fewer than Oby
highlights.phrase_id: Indy memiliki 28 stiker lebih sedikit daripada Oby

highlights.phrase_en: how many stickers altogether
highlights.note_en: Add all five people's stickers.
highlights.note_id: Jumlahkan stiker semua lima orang.

strategy.name_en: Follow the chain of relationships
strategy.name_id: Ikuti rantai hubungan

questions.body_en:
What is the smallest 5-digit even number that can be formed using the digits in the list below?
2, 4, 1, 9, 3, 7
questions.body_id:
Bilangan genap 5 angka terkecil manakah yang dapat dibentuk menggunakan daftar angka di bawah ini?
2, 4, 1, 9, 3, 7

highlights.note_en: Choose any 5 of these 6 digits.
highlights.note_id: Pilih 5 dari 6 digit ini.

highlights.phrase_en: smallest 5-digit even number
highlights.note_en: Even means last digit is 2 or 4. Smallest means start with 1.
highlights.note_id: Genap artinya digit terakhir 2 atau 4. Terkecil artinya mulai dengan 1.

highlights.phrase_en: can be formed using the digits
highlights.note_en: Pick 5 digits, arrange smallest first, end with an even digit.
highlights.note_id: Pilih 5 digit, susun terkecil di depan, akhiri dengan digit genap.

strategy.name_en: Build from left: smallest first, even last
strategy.name_id: Bangun dari kiri: terkecil dulu, genap di akhir

trap.why_en: 12347 ends in 7 which is odd, so it is not even.
trap.why_id: 12347 berakhir dengan 7 yang ganjil, jadi bukan bilangan genap.

hint_steps_en: The last digit must be even. The smallest even digit left is 4.
That leaves 7 for the tens place: 1 2 3 7 4 = 12374.
hint_steps_id: Digit terakhir harus genap. Digit genap terkecil yang tersisa adalah 4.

questions.body_en:
What will come next?
one – two – four – eight – ?

satu – dua – empat – delapan – ?

highlights.phrase_en: one – two – four – eight
highlights.note_en: 1, 2, 4, 8 — each number is double the one before.
highlights.note_id: 1, 2, 4, 8 — setiap bilangan dua kali lipat dari sebelumnya.

highlights.phrase_en: What will come next?
highlights.phrase_id: Angka berapakah yang akan muncul berikutnya?
highlights.note_en: Double 8 to get the next number.
highlights.note_id: Dua kali lipat 8 untuk mendapatkan bilangan berikutnya.

strategy.name_en: Identify the pattern rule (multiply by 2)
strategy.name_id: Temukan aturan pola (kalikan 2)

hint_steps_en: Look at the pattern: 1, 2, 4, 8. Each number is doubled.

questions.body_en: At what time are the hour hand and minute hand directly opposite each other (forming a straight line of 180°)?
questions.body_id: Pada pukul berapakah jarum jam dan jarum menit saling berlawanan arah (membentuk garis lurus 180°)?

highlights.phrase_en: directly opposite each other (forming a straight line of 180°)
highlights.note_en: The two hands must point in exactly opposite directions.
highlights.note_id: Kedua jarum harus menunjuk ke arah yang berlawanan persis.

highlights.phrase_en: At what time
highlights.note_en: Check each option on a clock face.
highlights.note_id: Periksa setiap pilihan pada wajah jam.

quantities.label_en: At 06:00 — hour hand at 6, minute hand at 12
quantities.label_id: Pukul 06:00 — jarum jam di 6, jarum menit di 12

strategy.name_en: Check each clock time for exact 180°
strategy.name_id: Periksa setiap waktu jam untuk sudut tepat 180°

trap.why_en: At 12:00 both hands overlap at 12, making 0° not 180°.
trap.why_id: Pukul 12:00 kedua jarum bertumpuk di 12, membentuk 0° bukan 180°.

hint_steps_en: 180° means the two hands point in exactly opposite directions.
At 06:00: minute hand points to 12, hour hand points to 6 — perfectly opposite.
At 12:00 both hands point to 12 (0°, not 180°).
hint_steps_id: 180° berarti kedua jarum menunjuk ke arah yang berlawanan persis.
Pukul 06:00: jarum menit ke 12, jarum jam ke 6 — berlawanan sempurna.
Pukul 12:00 kedua jarum menunjuk ke 12 (0°, bukan 180°).

questions.body_en: Oby went to bed at night and noticed that the minute hand was pointing at 6 and the hour hand was pointing exactly between 10 and 11. He woke up when the minute hand was pointing at 6 but the hour hand pointed exactly between 6 and 7. How many hours did Oby sleep?
questions.body_id: Oby pergi tidur di malam hari dan memperhatikan bahwa jarum menit menunjuk ke angka 6 dan jarum jam menunjuk tepat di antara 10 dan 11. Dia bangun tidur ketika jarum menit menunjuk ke angka 6 tetapi jarum jam menunjuk tepat di antara 6 dan 7. Berapa jam Oby tidur?

highlights.phrase_en: minute hand was pointing at 6 and the hour hand was pointing exactly between 10 and 11
highlights.phrase_id: jarum menit menunjuk ke angka 6 dan jarum jam menunjuk tepat di antara 10 dan 11
highlights.note_en: Minute at 6 = :30. Hour between 10 and 11 at :30 → sleep time is 10:30 PM.
highlights.note_id: Menit di 6 = :30. Jam antara 10 dan 11 saat :30 → waktu tidur 22:30.

highlights.phrase_en: hour hand pointed exactly between 6 and 7
highlights.phrase_id: jarum jam menunjuk tepat di antara 6 dan 7
highlights.note_en: Minute at 6 = :30. Hour between 6 and 7 at :30 → wake time is 6:30 AM.
highlights.note_id: Menit di 6 = :30. Jam antara 6 dan 7 saat :30 → waktu bangun 06:30.

highlights.phrase_en: How many hours did Oby sleep?
highlights.note_en: Count from 10:30 PM to 6:30 AM.
highlights.note_id: Hitung dari 22:30 hingga 06:30.

strategy.name_en: Read clock → subtract times
strategy.name_id: Baca jam → kurangi waktu

hint_steps_en: Minute hand at 6 = half past. Hour between 10 and 11 at half past → went to bed at 10:30 PM.
Hour between 6 and 7 at half past → woke up at 6:30 AM.
hint_steps_id: Jarum menit di 6 = setengah. Jam antara 10 dan 11 saat setengah → tidur pukul 22:30.
Jam antara 6 dan 7 saat setengah → bangun pukul 06:30.

questions.body_en:
What number is correct for X?
Row 1: 6, 8, 4 → 12
Row 2: 4, 9, 3 → 12
Row 3: 9, 8, 12 → X
questions.body_id:
Bilangan berapakah yang tepat untuk mengisi X?
Baris 1: 6, 8, 4 → 12
Baris 2: 4, 9, 3 → 12
Baris 3: 9, 8, 12 → X

highlights.note_en: Test: 6 × 8 ÷ 4 = 12. This rule works!
highlights.note_id: Coba: 6 × 8 ÷ 4 = 12. Aturan ini berhasil!

highlights.note_en: Verify: 4 × 9 ÷ 3 = 12. Rule confirmed.
highlights.note_id: Verifikasi: 4 × 9 ÷ 3 = 12. Aturan terkonfirmasi.

highlights.note_en: Apply the rule: 9 × 8 ÷ 12 = X.
highlights.note_id: Terapkan aturan: 9 × 8 ÷ 12 = X.

strategy.name_en: Spot the hidden rule, then apply it
strategy.name_id: Temukan aturan tersembunyi, lalu terapkan

trap.why_en: The result isn't always 12 — it changes when the third number changes.
trap.why_id: Hasilnya tidak selalu 12 — berubah ketika bilangan ketiga berubah.

hint_steps_en: Find the pattern: 6×8÷4=12 and 4×9÷3=12. Rule: first × second ÷ third.
hint_steps_id: Temukan pola: 6×8÷4=12 dan 4×9÷3=12. Aturan: pertama × kedua ÷ ketiga.

questions.body_en: A clock stopped 3 and a half hours ago and showed 08:45 AM. What is the correct current time?
questions.body_id: Sebuah jam mati 3 setengah jam yang lalu dan menunjukkan pukul 08:45. Pukul berapakah waktu yang tepat saat ini?

highlights.phrase_en: stopped 3 and a half hours ago and showed 08:45 AM
highlights.phrase_id: mati 3 setengah jam yang lalu dan menunjukkan pukul 08:45
highlights.note_en: The clock froze at 08:45. It stopped 3.5 hours ago.
highlights.note_id: Jam berhenti di 08:45. Jam tersebut mati 3,5 jam yang lalu.

highlights.phrase_en: What is the correct current time?
highlights.phrase_id: Pukul berapakah waktu yang tepat saat ini?
highlights.note_en: Add 3.5 hours to 08:45 AM.
highlights.note_id: Tambahkan 3,5 jam ke pukul 08:45.

strategy.name_en: Add elapsed time to the frozen clock reading
strategy.name_id: Tambahkan waktu yang berlalu ke bacaan jam yang berhenti

trap.why_id: 08:45 pagi + 3,5 jam = 12:15 siang (PM), bukan AM (tengah malam).

hint_steps_en: The clock stopped at 08:45 AM, and that was 3.5 hours ago.
hint_steps_id: Jam berhenti pukul 08:45, dan itu terjadi 3,5 jam yang lalu.

questions.body_en:
Choose the correct answer!
15 □ 5 □ 3 □ 4 = □
questions.body_id:
Pilihlah jawaban yang tepat!
15 □ 5 □ 3 □ 4 = □

highlights.note_en: Fill in operators and the result. Remember order of operations.
highlights.note_id: Isi operatornya dan hasilnya. Ingat urutan operasi.

highlights.phrase_en: Choose the correct answer!
highlights.note_en: Test each option — only one gives a consistent result.
highlights.note_id: Uji setiap pilihan — hanya satu yang memberi hasil konsisten.

strategy.name_en: Try each option and apply order of operations
strategy.name_id: Coba setiap pilihan dan terapkan urutan operasi

trap.why_en: Option A uses same operators as D (+,×,+) but claims result 64 — wrong calculation.
trap.why_id: Pilihan A menggunakan operator yang sama dengan D (+,×,+) tapi mengklaim hasilnya 64 — perhitungan salah.

hint_steps_en: That matches the result in D, so D is correct.
hint_steps_id: Itu sesuai hasil di pilihan D, jadi D benar.

questions.body_en: Oby is thinking of a number. When he divides it by 4, the answer is 9 with some left over. If he adds 3 to the number and then divides by 4, there is nothing left over. What is Oby's number?
questions.body_id: Oby sedang memikirkan sebuah bilangan. Ketika ia membaginya dengan 4, jawabannya adalah 9 dengan sisa tertentu. Jika ia menambahkan 3 pada bilangan tersebut lalu dibagi 4, tidak ada sisa. Berapakah bilangan yang dipikirkan Oby?

highlights.phrase_en: divides it by 4, the answer is 9 with some left over
highlights.phrase_id: membaginya dengan 4, jawabannya adalah 9 dengan sisa tertentu
highlights.note_en: The number is between 36 (9×4) and 39 (less than 40). So 37, 38, or 39.
highlights.note_id: Bilangan tersebut antara 36 (9×4) dan 39 (kurang dari 40). Jadi 37, 38, atau 39.

highlights.phrase_en: adds 3 to the number and then divides by 4, there is nothing left over
highlights.phrase_id: menambahkan 3 pada bilangan tersebut lalu dibagi 4, tidak ada sisa
highlights.note_en: n + 3 is divisible by 4.
highlights.note_id: n + 3 habis dibagi 4.

highlights.phrase_en: What is Oby's number?
highlights.note_en: Test 37: 37+3=40, 40÷4=10 exactly. Yes!

strategy.name_en: Narrow the range, then test each candidate
strategy.name_id: Persempit rentang, lalu uji setiap kandidat

hint_steps_en: Quotient is 9 → the number is between 37 and 39 (not 36 which divides evenly).
hint_steps_id: Hasil bagi adalah 9 → bilangan tersebut antara 37 dan 39 (bukan 36 yang habis dibagi).

questions.body_en: Today is Wednesday, March 15, 2025. Ina's birthday is exactly 100 days later. On what date will her birthday be?

highlights.phrase_en: exactly 100 days later
highlights.note_en: Count: March remaining + April + May + June.
highlights.note_id: Hitung: sisa Maret + April + Mei + Juni.

highlights.phrase_en: On what date will her birthday be?
highlights.note_en: Find which day in June the count lands.

strategy.name_en: Count remaining days month by month
strategy.name_id: Hitung sisa hari per bulan

hint_steps_en: Days left in March: 31–15=16. April=30, May=31. Total so far: 16+30+31=77 days.
hint_steps_id: Sisa hari di Maret: 31–15=16. April=30, Mei=31. Total sejauh ini: 16+30+31=77 hari.

questions.body_en: Bony is 5 years old and his sister is 9 years old. In how many years will the sum of their ages be 30?
questions.body_id: Bony berusia 5 tahun sedangkan saudara perempuannya berusia 9 tahun. Dalam berapa tahun lagikah jumlah usia mereka akan menjadi 30?

highlights.phrase_en: Bony is 5 years old and his sister is 9 years old
highlights.phrase_id: Bony berusia 5 tahun sedangkan saudara perempuannya berusia 9 tahun
highlights.note_en: Current sum of ages = 5 + 9 = 14.
highlights.note_id: Jumlah usia saat ini = 5 + 9 = 14.

highlights.phrase_en: sum of their ages be 30
highlights.note_en: Each year, the sum grows by 2 (both age by 1).
highlights.note_id: Setiap tahun, jumlah bertambah 2 (keduanya bertambah 1).

highlights.phrase_en: In how many years
highlights.note_en: Solve: 14 + 2x = 30.
highlights.note_id: Selesaikan: 14 + 2x = 30.

strategy.name_en: Sum increases by 2 each year
strategy.name_id: Jumlah bertambah 2 setiap tahun

hint_steps_en: Each year both get older, so the sum grows by 2 per year.
hint_steps_id: Setiap tahun keduanya bertambah tua, sehingga jumlah bertambah 2 per tahun.

questions.body_en:
What is the sum of all the letters (A + B + C + D)?
AB + BB = ACD (a 2-digit addition where each letter is a distinct digit)
questions.body_id:
Berapakah jumlah dari semua huruf (A + B + C + D)?
AB + BB = ACD (penjumlahan 2 angka di mana setiap huruf mewakili digit berbeda)

highlights.phrase_en: each letter is a distinct digit
highlights.note_en: A, B, C, D are all different single digits.
highlights.note_id: A, B, C, D semuanya digit berbeda.

highlights.phrase_en: AB + BB = ACD
highlights.note_en: AB is a 2-digit number. ACD is a 3-digit number starting with A.
highlights.note_id: AB adalah bilangan 2 digit. ACD adalah bilangan 3 digit yang dimulai dengan A.

highlights.phrase_en: sum of all the letters (A + B + C + D)
highlights.phrase_id: jumlah dari semua huruf (A + B + C + D)
highlights.note_en: Find A, B, C, D then add them all.
highlights.note_id: Temukan A, B, C, D lalu jumlahkan semuanya.

strategy.name_en: Work from hundreds digit, try candidates for B
strategy.name_id: Mulai dari digit ratusan, coba kandidat untuk B

hint_steps_en: ACD is 3 digits from a 2-digit addition, so A=1 (carry). Try B=8: 18+88=106.
That gives A=1, C=0, D=6. All digits distinct: 1,8,0,6 ✓.
hint_steps_id: ACD adalah 3 digit dari penjumlahan 2 digit, jadi A=1 (ada angka simpanan). Coba B=8: 18+88=106.
Itu memberi A=1, C=0, D=6. Semua digit berbeda: 1,8,0,6 ✓.

questions.body_en: How many triangles are in this picture?
questions.body_id: Ada berapa banyak segitiga pada gambar ini?

highlights.phrase_en: How many triangles are in this picture?
highlights.phrase_id: Ada berapa banyak segitiga pada gambar ini?
highlights.note_en: Count triangles of all sizes — small, medium, and large.
highlights.note_id: Hitung segitiga dari semua ukuran — kecil, sedang, dan besar.

strategy.name_en: Count by size: small, medium, large
strategy.name_id: Hitung berdasarkan ukuran: kecil, sedang, besar

trap.why_en: Easy to miss compound triangles formed by combining smaller ones.
trap.why_id: Mudah melewatkan segitiga majemuk yang terbentuk dari gabungan segitiga kecil.

hint_steps_en: Start by counting the smallest triangles.
Then count medium triangles (made of 2 small ones), then large (made of 4 or more).
Add all sizes together to get 20.
hint_steps_id: Lalu hitung segitiga sedang (dari 2 kecil), kemudian yang besar (dari 4 atau lebih).

questions.body_en: A rectangle has a perimeter of 30 cm. If one side is 3 cm longer than its width, what is the area of the rectangle in cm²?
questions.body_id: Sebuah persegi panjang memiliki keliling 30 cm. Jika salah satu sisi 3 cm lebih panjang dari sisi lebarnya, berapakah luas persegi panjang tersebut dalam cm²?

highlights.phrase_en: perimeter of 30 cm
highlights.note_en: Perimeter = 2 × (length + width) = 30, so length + width = 15.
highlights.note_id: Keliling = 2 × (panjang + lebar) = 30, jadi panjang + lebar = 15.

highlights.phrase_en: one side is 3 cm longer than its width
highlights.phrase_id: salah satu sisi 3 cm lebih panjang dari sisi lebarnya
highlights.note_en: length = width + 3.
highlights.note_id: panjang = lebar + 3.

highlights.phrase_en: what is the area of the rectangle in cm²
highlights.phrase_id: berapakah luas persegi panjang tersebut dalam cm²
highlights.note_en: Area = length × width.
highlights.note_id: Luas = panjang × lebar.

strategy.name_en: Use perimeter to find l+w, then solve for each side
strategy.name_id: Gunakan keliling untuk mencari p+l, lalu cari setiap sisi

hint_steps_en: Perimeter = 2(l+w) = 30, so l+w = 15. Also l = w+3.
hint_steps_id: Keliling = 2(p+l) = 30, jadi p+l = 15. Dan p = l+3.

questions.body_en: Oby has chickens, cows, and sheep on his farm. There are twice as many chickens as cows. The number of sheep is 3 more than the number of cows. If the total number of animal legs is 144, how many animals does Oby have on the farm?
questions.body_id: Oby memiliki ayam, sapi dan domba di peternakannya. Jumlah ayam dua kali lebih banyak dari sapi. Jumlah domba 3 ekor lebih banyak dari jumlah sapi. Jika total kaki semua hewan adalah 144, berapa banyak hewan yang dimiliki Oby di peternakan?

highlights.phrase_en: There are twice as many chickens as cows. The number of sheep is 3 more than the number of cows.
highlights.phrase_id: Jumlah ayam dua kali lebih banyak dari sapi. Jumlah domba 3 ekor lebih banyak dari jumlah sapi.
highlights.note_en: chickens=2c, sheep=c+3 where c=number of cows.
highlights.note_id: ayam=2c, domba=c+3 di mana c=jumlah sapi.

highlights.phrase_en: total number of animal legs is 144
highlights.note_en: Chickens have 2 legs, cows and sheep have 4 legs each.
highlights.note_id: Ayam memiliki 2 kaki, sapi dan domba masing-masing 4 kaki.

highlights.phrase_en: how many animals does Oby have on the farm
highlights.phrase_id: berapa banyak hewan yang dimiliki Oby di peternakan
highlights.note_en: Find c, then add all three animal counts.
highlights.note_id: Cari c, lalu jumlahkan ketiga jenis hewan.

strategy.name_en: Express everything in terms of c, solve for c
strategy.name_id: Nyatakan semua dalam c, selesaikan untuk c

hint_steps_en: Let cows=c. Chickens=2c (2 legs each), sheep=c+3 (4 legs each), cows=c (4 legs each).
hint_steps_id: Misalkan sapi=c. Ayam=2c (2 kaki), domba=c+3 (4 kaki), sapi=c (4 kaki).
